chunks: From him, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Hāshim, from Ibn Miskān, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The ʿatamah is until one-third of the night, or until the middle of the night, and that is neglect.

key_terms.التَّضْيِيعُ: neglect or undue delay in performing the prayer
key_terms.اللَّيْلِ: the night, used to define the prayer's timing
key_terms.الْعَتَمَةُ: the ʿisha' prayer, referred to by its nighttime designation
key_terms.ثُلُثِ: one-third portion, here referring to one-third of the night
key_terms.نِصْفِ: half, here referring to the midpoint of the night

ai.seo_question: Until when may the ʿisha' prayer be delayed, and is delaying it considered neglect?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the time of the ʿisha' prayer and indicates that delaying it until one-third or halfway through the night constitutes neglect. It is used in discussions of the proper and preferred timing of salat.
